takes.action: The ORVO trail shoe stands on a sandstone pillar in a desert storm, sand and debris whipping past in the low sun; the FPV camera rushes toward it in one fast push-in.
The FPV camera skims low over the shoe's upper like a drone over a landscape, the ripstop weave and burnt-orange overlays sliding past, the laces rising ahead like bridges as sand streaks by.
The camera dives through an eyelet into the material maze, bright light strobing through the mesh in hard beams, burnt-orange lace walls passing on both sides, dust hanging in the light.
A barrel roll beneath the outsole: the black lugs pass overhead like a mountain range, debris flying, the ORVO on the heel flashing past.
The camera bursts out as the same shoe, now on the runner's foot, strikes the red-rock trail mid-stride, lugs biting, sand spraying, and springs off into the next stride toward the storm.
PACKSHOT: the ORVO trail shoe hangs in the centre of the frame above the red-rock trail, sand drifting slowly around it in the warm light; the camera eases back and holds.
